extraction.title: Star wars
extraction.subtitle: Jeff Bezos is raising his game in space But it will be hard for Amazon and Blue Origin to close the gap with SpaceX
extraction.summary: Blue Origin's recent launch of the New Glenn rocket ended in failure as it placed its payload in the wrong orbit, leading to an investigation by the FAA. This setback comes as Amazon invests heavily in satellite internet services to compete with SpaceX's Starlink.
